title: 第12章  大掠夺仙术，疯狂屠杀！
content_zh:
圣女峰。炼丹房。
“如烟，为师只能帮你到这里了，至于你能不能突破桎梏，就看你自己的造化了。”
姬邀月将一枚丹药交到柳如烟手中，语气凝重道。
身为一名炼丹师，她现在能为柳如烟做的事情，就是为她的突破，提供最直接的帮助，而她给她炼制的这枚破障五行丹，凝聚着她的心血，也充满了她的期望。
“多谢师尊！”
柳如烟接过丹药，行了一礼，眼神中有着一丝满意。
姬邀月为她炼制的丹药，也正是狐师所提到的，能够助她短时间内突破修为，甚至，连番突破修为的最强大保障！
就在这时候，忽然姬邀月一口鲜血吐出，气息也萎靡了下去。
“师尊！”
柳如烟着急将人搀扶着，姬邀月却摆摆手，然后将一枚丹药吞下。
“这破障五行丹的品级，应该无限接近于地品丹，这已经是为师能炼制出来的至高品级丹药，如烟，但愿你不会辜负为师的期望，到时候一定要大败陆烬，继而加入血月圣地！”
几乎所有人都知道，一旦有弟子被血月圣地收了，那么其身后家族或者势力，将会得到巨大好处！
每一年血月圣地都会赠予巨额财富，包括各种丹药，功法，战兵，甚至一些其他门派挣破脑袋都抢不到的机缘！
而作为师尊，得到的好处会更多！
甚至曾经有弟子加入血月圣地之后，其师尊在短时间内得到巨大好处，被灌顶提升，成为一方巨擘！
甚至一些宗派的发展上限，完全取决于血月圣地所赠予财富的多寡！
若能获得一部超级功法，极有可能一个宗门强者辈出，从而脱胎换骨，一跃而成为一方大势力！
姬邀月的想法正是如此，相对于血月圣地的奖励来说，她现在的付出，就显得微不足道了。
柳如烟带着破障五行丹，离开了炼丹房，然后驾驭一头飞行坐骑，一路朝着北方疾飞。
最后，竟是飞到了一处宗派上空停了下来。

“狐师，您准备好了吗？”
柳如烟看着下方宗派热闹的场面，眼神浮现出一抹嗜血贪婪。
而当她的话音落下，顿时一股黑色灵气从体内涌出，顿时便将她的周身笼罩，而她一行一动间，黑色雾气缭绕，将其渲染得宛若魔女。
“去吧，这一次，为师全力助你！”
柳如烟眼神一寒，体内灵气迸射，手中一把黑色长剑闪现而出，竟是首先将脚下坐骑一剑斩碎！
当坐骑血液飙射而出之时，那黑色长剑顿时一股吞噬之力涌出，竟是将那鲜血瞬间抽干！
而与此同时，柳如烟体内，那至尊骨精光一闪，旋即恢复如常。
只是那上方隐约多出了一道淡淡符文。
“大掠夺仙术，哈哈哈，给我杀！”
柳如烟眸色嗜血，竟是瞬间从天而降，宛若妖魔降世，手握黑光长剑，对着下方宗派弟子，疯狂屠杀！
而每一次屠戮，黑光长剑的吞噬之力便瞬间将人血抽干，尸体直接变成了干尸！
那宗派中并无太强大之人坐镇，其宗主也不过七重灵珠境而已！
而整个宗门中的混乱并没有持续太长时间，便完全销声匿迹。
上百干尸横陈，空气中的血腥很快烟消云散。
疯狂屠杀了一个宗门后，柳如烟吞下破障五行丹，化为一道黑色魔光，消失于黑暗森林深处。
“嗯？开山宗竟被灭门了？”
不知过去多久，一男一女两道人影从开山宗上空飞过去，当看到下方横七竖八的干尸时，二人眸色顿时皱起。
“莫尘师兄，难道，这又是血使者做的？”
那女子一袭蓝衣，长发披肩，面容姣好，身材也是颇为高挑出众，手中却握着一把跟她出尘气质颇不匹配的长刀。
“血使者一般都会直接将活人抓走献给血月老祖，这开山宗的情形，倒是有些不一样。”

叫莫尘的男子星眸剑眉，颇为俊朗，气息强大，二人竟都是金丹境强者。
他闪身降落下去，查探一番无果后，便带着蓝衣女子离开了。
而他们所前往的地方，赫然便是万剑宗。
万剑宗戒备森严，并不是什么人都能随便进入的。
可当二人来到万剑宗山门后，那莫尘手中一道玄光飞出，赫然是一只玄色飞鸟，当那飞鸟飞出后，万剑宗守门弟子却面色一变，然后对着二人点了点头，眼看着二人进入山门深处。
而莫尘和蓝衣女子最后则是随着飞鸟，一路来到宗主楚天雄所在之地。
他寻常时候根本找不到踪影，可随着飞鸟一路飞奔，却很快找到了他。
“堂主！”
莫尘二人毕恭毕敬行了一礼。
楚天雄点点头，开门见山：
“有情况？”
“堂主！我和紫萱师妹路过开山宗，发现整个宗门都被屠戮殆尽，而且所有人都变成了人干，毫无血色，这应该不是血使者干的。”
楚天雄闻言皱眉。
“开山宗被灭门了？可曾查到些蛛丝马迹？”
莫尘无奈摇头。
“好，此事本座知道了，我会亲自去查。”
“你们如今在血月圣地如何？”
紫萱说道：
“堂主，血月老祖如今实力越发强大，需要的血食也越来越多，血使者每天抓去的活人不下上百！而且血月老祖如今已经彻底陷入闭关修炼状态，别说我们，就是圣地四大家族之人想要见他，都难如登天。”
楚天雄微微蹙眉，闭了闭眼，旋即抓过二人手腕，眼神一瞥，微微摇头。

“你二人的血月咒印记越发深了！以后行事务必要更加小心，本座知道你们的心思，不过，成大事者，不拘小节，暂时性的隐忍屈辱，所有的不甘，都要咽下去！”
“堂主，我们知道！”
“为圣堂，我等甘愿赴死！”
二人眼神决然。
“本座不要你们死，本座要你们亲眼看着血月圣地老祖，死无葬身之地！”
当二人刚刚走出万剑宗，楚天雄也消失在宗门之内。
他要做的事情，隐蔽而神秘，却如同一股暗流，蓄势待发…
“嗡！”
而就在这时候，紫萱指尖纳戒中，忽然一道传音符波动传出，她眸色大变！
“不好了莫师兄，凌涛被困在火蛟洞窟，生死未卜！”
“你是说，雷渊禁地的火蛟洞窟？”
content_en:
Virgin Peak. Alchemy room.
"Ruyan, my teacher can only help you so far. As for whether you can break through the shackles, it depends on your own destiny."
Ji Yaoyue handed a pill into Liu Ruyan's hand and said solemnly.
As an alchemist, what she can do for Liu Ruyan now is to provide the most direct help for her breakthrough, and the barrier-breaking Five Elements Pill she refined for her embodies her hard work and is full of her expectations.
"Thank you Master!"
Liu Ruyan took the elixir and bowed, with a trace of satisfaction in her eyes.
The elixir that Ji Yaoyue refined for her was exactly what Master Fox mentioned. It could help her break through her cultivation level in a short time, or even be the most powerful guarantee for her to break through her cultivation level repeatedly!
At this moment, Ji Yaoyue suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood, and her breath became weak.
"Master!"
Liu Ruyan hurriedly supported the person, but Ji Yaoyue waved her hand and swallowed a pill.
"The grade of this Barrier-Breaking Five Elements Pill should be infinitely close to that of the Earth-grade Pill. This is already the highest-grade pill that I can refine, like smoke. I hope you will not disappoint my expectations. When the time comes, you must defeat Lu Jin and then join the Blood Moon Holy Land!"
Almost everyone knows that once a disciple is accepted by the Blood Moon Holy Land, the family or force behind him will receive huge benefits!
Every year, Blood Moon Holy Land will give away huge wealth, including various elixirs, exercises, soldiers, and even some opportunities that other sects can't even try to grab!
And as a master, you will get even more benefits!
There was even a disciple who joined the Blood Moon Holy Land, and his master received huge benefits in a short period of time, was initiated and promoted, and became a giant!
Even the upper limit of the development of some sects depends entirely on the amount of wealth donated by the Blood Moon Holy Land!
If a super skill can be obtained, it is very likely that a strong sect will emerge in large numbers, and thus be reborn and become a powerful force in one fell swoop!
This is exactly what Ji Yaoyue thinks. Compared with the rewards from the Blood Moon Holy Land, her current efforts seem insignificant.
Liu Ruyan left the alchemy room with the Barrier-Breaking Five Elements Pill, then rode a flying mount and flew towards the north.
Finally, it actually flew to the sky above a sect and stopped.
"Master Fox, are you ready?"
Liu Ruyan looked at the lively scene of the sect below, with a trace of bloodthirsty and greed in his eyes.
And when her voice fell, a black aura suddenly surged out of her body, immediately covering her whole body, and every move she made was filled with black mist, rendering her like a witch.
"Go ahead, this time, I will help you with all my strength!"
Liu Ruyan's eyes turned cold, spiritual energy burst out from his body, and a black long sword flashed out in his hand, and he was the first to chop the mount under his feet into pieces!
When the mount's blood spurted out, the black long sword suddenly surged out with devouring power, draining the blood instantly!
At the same time, within Liu Ruyan's body, the supreme bone essence flashed and returned to normal immediately.
It's just that there is a faint rune on the top.
"Great plundering magic, hahaha, kill me!"
Liu Ruyan's bloodthirsty eyes suddenly fell from the sky, like a demon coming to the world, holding a black light sword in his hand, and slaughtered the sect disciples below like crazy!
And every time there was a killing, the devouring power of the black light sword instantly drained the blood of the people, and the corpses turned directly into mummies!
There is no very powerful person in that sect, and its leader is only at the seventh level of the Spiritual Bead Realm!
The chaos in the entire sect did not last long and disappeared completely.
Hundreds of mummies lay everywhere, and the blood in the air quickly disappeared.
After frantically massacring a sect, Liu Ruyan swallowed the Barrier-breaking Five Elements Pill and turned into a black magic light, disappearing deep into the dark forest.
"Huh? The Kaishan Sect was actually wiped out?"
I don’t know how much time passed, but two figures, a man and a woman, flew over the Kaishan Sect.Go, when they saw the mummies lying scattered below, their eyes suddenly wrinkled.
"Senior Brother Mo Chen, could it be that the Blood Messenger did this again?"
The woman was dressed in blue, with long hair hanging over her shoulders. She had a pretty face and a tall and outstanding figure, but she held a long knife in her hand that did not match her aura.
"The Blood Messenger usually captures the living people and sacrifices them to the Blood Moon Ancestor. The situation in the Founding Sect is a little different."
The man named Mo Chen has star eyes and sword eyebrows. He is quite handsome and has a powerful aura. Both of them are actually strong men in the Golden Core Realm.
He dodged and landed, and after checking to no avail, he left with the woman in blue.
And the place they were heading to was the Wanjian Sect.
Wanjian Sect is heavily guarded and not just anyone can enter.
But when the two came to the gate of Wanjian Sect, a mysterious light flew out of Mo Chen's hand. It was a black flying bird. When the bird flew out, the expression of the gatekeeper disciple of Wanjian Sect changed. Then he nodded to the two of them and watched them enter the depths of the mountain gate.
Mo Chen and the woman in blue followed Feiniao all the way to the place where the sect leader Chu Tianxiong was.
Normally, he could not be found at all, but as the bird flew all the way, he was quickly found.
"Hall Master!"
Mo Chen and the other two bowed respectfully.
Chu Tianxiong nodded and got straight to the point:
"Is there a situation?"
"Hall Master! Junior Sister Zixuan and I passed by Kaishan Sect and found that the entire sect had been slaughtered, and everyone had turned into human beings, bloodless. This should not have been done by the Blood Messenger."
Chu Tianxiong frowned when he heard this.
"The Kaishan Sect was exterminated? Have you found any clues?"
Mo Chen shook his head helplessly.
"Okay, I know about this, and I will investigate it myself."
"How are you doing in the Blood Moon Holy Land now?"
Zixuan said:
"Hall Master, the Blood Moon Ancestor is becoming more and more powerful now, and needs more and more blood food. The Blood Messenger captures no less than a hundred people every day! Moreover, the Blood Moon Ancestor has now completely fallen into seclusion and practice. Not to mention us, even the four major families in the Holy Land have a hard time meeting him."
Chu Tianxiong frowned slightly, closed his eyes, and immediately grabbed their wrists, glanced at them, and shook his head slightly.
"The marks of the Blood Moon Curse on you two are getting deeper and deeper! You must be more careful when doing things in the future. I know your thoughts. However, those who achieve great things will not stick to trivial matters and temporarily endure humiliation. All unwillingness must be swallowed!"
"Master, we know!"
"For the Holy Church, we are willing to die!"
The two looked at each other with determination.
"I don't want you to die. I want you to see the ancestors of the Blood Moon Holy Land die with your own eyes without a burial place!"
When the two of them just walked out of Wanjian Sect, Chu Tianxiong also disappeared from the sect.
What he wants to do is hidden and mysterious, but like an undercurrent, it is ready to go...
"Buzz!"
And at this moment, Zixuan held the ring on her fingertips, and suddenly a wave of sound transmission came out, and her eyes changed drastically!
"Old Brother Mo, Ling Tao is trapped in the Fire Dragon Cave, his life or death is uncertain!"
"You mean, the Fire Dragon Cave in the Forbidden Land of Leiyuan?"
